# `core/memory/HostMemoryManager.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/memory/HostMemoryManager.js`

HostMemoryManager.js - Zero-Runtime-Allocation Memory System Implements: - Slab Allocator for TypedArrays (per-frame linear allocation) - Object Pools for reusable JS objects (persistent lifecycle) - Structure of Arrays (SoA) for cache-efficient data layouts Goal: Eliminate GC pressure during the render loop

## Classes

### `class SlabAllocator`

Linear allocator that resets every frame. Provides zero-cost TypedArray views into a pre-allocated buffer.

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(sizeBytes = DEFAULT_SLAB_SIZE, name = 'default')` |  |
| `_align` | `_align(alignment)` | Align cursor to specified boundary |
| `allocBytes` | `allocBytes(bytes, alignment = ALIGNMENT_4)` | Allocate raw bytes from the slab |
| `_allocOverflow` | `_allocOverflow(bytes, alignment)` | Allocate from overflow page when main slab is full |
| `allocFloat32` | `allocFloat32(count)` | Allocate a Float32Array view |
| `allocUint32` | `allocUint32(count)` | Allocate a Uint32Array view |
| `allocUint8` | `allocUint8(count)` | Allocate a Uint8Array view |
| `allocMatrix4` | `allocMatrix4()` | Allocate a 4x4 matrix (16 floats, 64 bytes) |
| `allocVec3` | `allocVec3()` | Allocate a Vec3 (3 floats, padded to 4 for alignment) |
| `allocVec4` | `allocVec4()` | Allocate a Vec4 (4 floats) |
| `allocUniformBuffer` | `allocUniformBuffer(bytes)` | Allocate uniform buffer aligned memory |
| `reset` | `reset()` | Reset the allocator for a new frame Call this at the START of each frame |
| `getStats` | `getStats()` | Get usage statistics |

### `class ObjectPool`

Generic object pool for reusable JavaScript objects. Uses LIFO (stack) for hot cache retrieval.

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(factory, reset = null, initialCapacity = DEFAULT_POOL_CAPACITY, name = 'pool')` |  |
| `_createObject` | `_createObject()` | Create a new object via factory |
| `alloc` | `alloc()` | Acquire an object from the pool |
| `free` | `free(obj)` | Release an object back to the pool |
| `_expand` | `_expand()` | Expand pool capacity |
| `prewarm` | `prewarm(count)` | Pre-warm the pool by allocating and immediately freeing |
| `getStats` | `getStats()` | Get pool statistics |
| `enableDebugMode` | `enableDebugMode()` | Enable debug mode (seals new objects) |

### `class SoAContainer`

SoA container for cache-efficient mass entity storage. All properties stored in contiguous TypedArrays.

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(schema, capacity, name = 'soa')` |  |
| `alloc` | `alloc()` | Allocate a new entity slot |
| `free` | `free(index)` | Free an entity slot |
| `isActive` | `isActive(index)` | Check if entity is active |
| `get` | `get(propName, index, component = 0)` | Get property value for entity |
| `set` | `set(propName, index, value, component = 0)` | Set property value for entity |
| `setAll` | `setAll(propName, index, ...values)` | Set all components of a property |
| `getArray` | `getArray(propName)` | Get raw array for direct access (faster for bulk operations) |
| `forEach` | `forEach(callback)` | Iterate over all active entities |
| `compact` | `compact()` | Compact the arrays by removing gaps (expensive, use sparingly) |
| `getStats` | `getStats()` | Get statistics |
